parameters.query: SELECT m.id, m.current_milestone_date, m.responsible_org, p.name as program_name, p.id as program_id, o.name as org_name, o.id as org_id, cd.nist_id FROM milestones m JOIN programs p ON m.program_id = p.id JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id JOIN program_controls pc ON m.program_control_id = pc.id JOIN control_definitions cd ON pc.control_definition_id = cd.id WHERE m.is_complete = false AND m.current_milestone_date <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY m.current_milestone_date ASC
INSERT INTO activity_log (event_type, description, metadata) VALUES ('poam_reminder_sent', $1, $2::jsonb)
